reason: Small, well-tested bug fix in Lucene BooleanQueryProvider that adds a null/empty-key guard and returns early instead of relying on a possibly-null loop variable, changing behavior only for previously-broken (throwing) inputs like array filters, with low chance of regressing existing working queries.
